start.title: A Question of Love
start.text:
Jesus sits on the hill and asks,
"What man, having a hundred sheep...?"

choices.text: Turn away from the small story

turn_consequence.title: Stay a While
turn_consequence.text:
He tells it only for hearts like yours.
Come back and hear.

flock.title: The Hundred
flock.text:
A shepherd walks among his sheep,
knowing each one by name.

count_consequence.title: Each One Matters
count_consequence.text:
No sheep is worth less than another.
Not in his eyes.

lost.title: One Wanders
lost.text:
A small lamb slips beyond the rocks,
alone in the gathering dusk.

choices.text: Say it deserves to be lost
Hope the wolves find it first

blame_consequence.title: Mercy First
blame_consequence.text:
He does not weigh the lamb's fault.
He only wants it home.

cruel_consequence.title: Love Goes After
cruel_consequence.text:
Heaven does not abandon the small.
It runs to find them.

leave.title: Leaving the Ninety-Nine
leave.text:
He sets the flock by a sheltered rock,
and turns toward the dark hills.

choices.text: Tell him the one is not worth it
choices.feedback: To him, every one is worth it.

choices.text: Walk with him into the dusk

worth_consequence.title: Worth of One
worth_consequence.text:
He would leave ninety-nine for you.
That is how love counts.

choices.text: Walk with him into the dusk

search.title: Through the Valley
search.text:
Through mist and stone he calls its name,
lantern raised against the night.

choices.text: Give up when the path is hard
choices.feedback: He will not give up on you.

giveup_consequence.title: He Keeps Going
giveup_consequence.text:
Tired feet do not turn him back.
Love is stubborn that way.

found.title: Found
found.text:
At dawn he kneels in a quiet ravine,
and lifts the trembling lamb.

scold_consequence.title: Only Kindness
scold_consequence.text:
Not one harsh word leaves his mouth.
Only kindness, only joy.

carry.title: On His Shoulders
carry.text:
He lays the lamb across his shoulders,
and walks the long road home.

choices.text: Ask him to set it down to walk

walk_consequence.title: He Carries You
walk_consequence.text:
The lost are too tired to walk alone.
Let him carry.

celebration.title: Rejoice With Me
celebration.text:
He calls his friends, eyes shining,
"Rejoice! I have found my lost one."

envy_consequence.title: Joy for Each
envy_consequence.text:
Heaven rejoices over every one.
Every one means you.

ending.title: Heaven's Joy
ending.text:
Jesus smiles at you in the warm light.
"So heaven rejoices over one."
